content:
Press Release:

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:

CONTACT:
Steve Smith
JAMMIN’ DJs
(303) 308-9700
steve@myjammindjs.com

http://jammintrivia.com

Starting in October 19, 2011, JAMMIN’ DJs / JAMMIN’ TRIVIA will be starting an eight week, multi bar/restaurant, live trivia tournament.

Metro Denver, Colorado, Tuesday, October 25, 2011– One of Colorado’s hottest interactive bar trivia is hosting an eight week tournament between six local bars.  Each bar has multiple teams competing against each other to win the trivia game for the evening along with the grand prize for the tournament.

The multiple participating bars include: Platte River Bar and Grill, Off Broadway Lounge, Multiple Buffalo Wild Wings, C.B. and Potts, Highlands Ranch & DTC, Old Chicago along with The Tilted Kilt downtown.  The teams will be answering questions from different categories including sports, music, history, cartoons and mathematics along with many other miscellaneous categories. There are three rounds that make up the game consisting of 5 regular questions per round and a bonus question allowing the teams to wager their hard earned points on.  In addition we have a lightening round that incorporates audio/visual them for extra points.  At the end of the game, winners are determined according to their point standings.  Most locations winning team a bar tab.  Typical bar tabs are $50 for first, $25 for second and $10 for third place.  The highest cumulative scoring team for the tournament will win a night out on the town in a limousine to take up to 14 people around the six bars and get a $50 bar tab at each stop.

For additional information, visit us at http://jammintrivia.com or call (303) 308-9700.
